p2p_port.description: Port on which the daemon listens for incoming P2P connections.

p2p_bind_ip.description: IP address to bind the P2P interface to. Use '127.0.0.1' to restrict to local only.

p2p_incoming_enabled.description: Whether to accept incoming P2P connections. Disable to run as a client-only node.

rpc_port.description: Port for the JSON-RPC API (used by wallets, explorers, and tools).

rpc_bind_ip.description: IP to bind the RPC server to. Keep '127.0.0.1' for local-only access for security.

rpc_enabled.description: Enable the RPC server. Disable only if you use local RPC or a proxy.

rpc_login.description: Authentication credentials in 'username:password' format. Leave empty for no auth (not recommended for public nodes).

rpc_public.description: Whether to expose a public RPC endpoint without authentication (dangerous — only for trusted infrastructure).

data_dir.description: Directory where the blockchain and wallet data are stored.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. If empty or omitted, logs go to stderr.

max_concurrency.description: Maximum number of simultaneous P2P connections (peers). Adjust based on system resources.

limit_rate.description: Rate limit (in KB/s) for inbound/outbound traffic. 0 means no limit.

preserve_tx_fee.description: If true, preserves the transaction fee in the transaction output; otherwise, fee is deducted from the sender.

dnssec_enabled.description: Enable DNSSEC validation for Monero DNS seeds. Recommended for security.

seed_nodes.description: Optional list of trusted seed nodes (host:port) for bootstrap. Leave empty to use default seeds.

exclusive_nodes.description: List of trusted daemon nodes to exclusively use for syncing (comma-separated in raw config).

additional_nodes.description: Additional nodes to try connecting to (seed nodes for redundancy).

sync_enabled.description: Enable blockchain synchronization on startup. Disable for archival or offline nodes.

pruning_enabled.description: Enable blockchain pruning to reduce disk usage. Not compatible with all tools (e.g., some explorers).

pruning_threshold.description: Size (MB) threshold for pruning — disk space saved beyond this amount will be reclaimed.

mining_enabled.description: Enable local mining. Requires CPU and significant power — only for test or dedicated mining setups.

mining_threads.description: Number of mining threads. 0 = auto-detect. Recommended ≤ (logical cores - 1) to preserve system responsiveness.

mining_address.description: Monero address to receive mined rewards. Required if mining is enabled.

background_mining_enabled.description: Allow background mining when system is idle. May increase battery/CPU usage.

local_peer_discovery_enabled.description: Enable local network peer discovery (LAN). Safe in trusted environments.

rpc_allow_remote.description: Allow RPC connections from remote hosts. Not recommended — use a reverse proxy instead.

ipv6_enabled.description: Enable IPv6 support. Disable if IPv6 is misconfigured or unused.

upnp_enabled.description: Enable UPnP port mapping. May fail or cause issues on modern routers — use with caution.

rpc_max_connections.description: Maximum concurrent RPC connections. Increase for high-load wallet services.

rpc_max_request_size.description: Maximum RPC request size (bytes). Increase only if using large batch requests.

fee_override.description: Override minimum fee (e.g., '0.00001' XMR per KB). Use carefully — low fees may delay confirmations.

sync_snapshot_url.description: URL of a Monero blockchain snapshot for fast initial sync (e.g., 'auto' or full HTTPS URL).

zmq_enabled.description: Enable ZeroMQ for real-time pub/sub of blocks/transactions. Required for some services like block explorers.

zmq_pub_tx_addr.description: ZMQ address to publish raw transactions (e.g., 'tcp://127.0.0.1:18083').

zmq_pub_block_addr.description: ZMQ address to publish new blocks in JSON format.

zmq_pub_raw_block_addr.description: ZMQ address to publish raw (binary) blocks.

extra_lines.description: Unparsed additional configuration lines to append verbatim (for advanced or undocumented options).
